note: The Banking (Credit Reference Bureau) Regulations, 2020, as the Central Bank of Kenya publishes them: negative information on a non-performing loan (a bank's, unpaid ninety days or more) is reported after at least thirty days' written notice to the customer, written as 90 days, and kept five years from the default's final settlement.

sources.title: Central Bank of Kenya, The Banking (Credit Reference Bureau) Regulations, 2020
sources.said: when principal or interest is due and unpaid for ninety days or more ... notify the customer of the intention to submit ... the negative information at least thirty days before submitting the ... until the expiry of five years from the date of final settlement of the amount in default
